Hi everyone,

I have actually been on Voat for almost 8 months... I slowly made the transition from that *other* site. This is a rather tardy formal introduction, but now that I have formally deleted that other account entirely and permanently, I figure it is time.

As you can see from my history here, I make silly videos and post them to YouTube under the name Viva Frei. My claim to fame was a video of a squirrel stealing my GoPro (here it is: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4_gmkhE7YQc). Since then, I have just been make quirky videos, usually involving my drone, action cameras and animals, or dog, which I hope contribute to the overall happiness-pool of the world. It has become something of a hobby of mine - a fun outlet and distraction from the soul-crushing day-job of being a lawyer.

At that other site, I started "getting in trouble" because I was not respecting some 90% submission rule - apparently 9 out of 10 posts should *not* be your original content. If more than 1 of 10 posts is your original content or from your YouTube channel, it is considered spam, which will get you banned from the most popular subs (videos, funny, etc.).

It got worse when they announced the "no third-party agency" rule - meaning that if you use an agency to license your original content (agencies like Storyful, Jukin, Newsflare, Break, etc.), the video is *automatically* blocked and your account banned from the sub. The rationale was one that I never understood - something about agencies spamming the content through accounts not credited to the creator, so that views benefitted the agency and not the creator. I tried to explain that the rule only punished YouTubers in that it stifled original content (it is not the case for me, but some people survive off their original content and their ability to license it). I also tried to explain that this was really only an issue between the creator and agency, and that sooner or later, *every* viral video will have an agency licensing it. I told them that it would lead to a situation where there will no longer be any original content in the most popular subs - which is what I have noticed ultimately happened.

So here I am. The user-base is smaller, but the crowd is good. Hope you enjoy my videos. I may start a new channel soon (during my lunches, I have recently started dreaming of checking off a bucket list item and driving across the country). In the meantime, check me out at https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCzGiDDKdphJ0GFvEd82WfYQ?nohtml5=False

I also started a Facebook page for anyone who is interested in following: https://www.facebook.com/vivafrei

Viva la Voat!

this week i've got:

* **Batman/Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles #5** - second to last one of the series so if you aren't on it already, i'd just wait for the trade if you are that interested. it's fun but its definitely a nostalgia attempt by putting words and art to the action figure fights most of us probably used to make.

* **Gotham Academy #17** - this is yet another, albeit finally the last, of their short story 'yearbook' compilations. one was fine but now it is just fucking annoying especially when this was just an otherwise great book. i'm in it too deep to stop now though. really hoping it comes back to what it was after this finishes but with the new "DC ruins everything" event on the horizon, i don't have very high hopes.

* **Darth Vader #19** - still on board and it's still pretty strong but I am not certain if I will continue after this arc wraps up. we'll see.

* **Gwenpool #1** - been excited about this one since it was first announced. I love Chris Hastings so I am really looking forward to it.

* **Moon Knight #1** - I was a big fan of the fairly recent Ellis Moon Knight run and was still fine with it when it was continued by Wood then Bunn. unfortunately, it was a book that just kind of phased out and ended with no real end after the secret wars crap took over and ruined a bunch of things.   • Gotham Academy #17: On the flip side, I was really happy to see Gotham Academy was in the line-up. It'll be nice to get the title back going forward instead of all the flashback issues.

  • Amazing Spider-man #10: It was nice to see Mr. Negative back in the Spider titles and this Zodiac story is really starting to pick up and get interesting (despite my initial misgivings about Peter Parker being just too well off).

  • Spider-Gwen #7: Part 2 of Spider-women. Haven't read part one yet, but looking forward to reading them both this week.

If you want the "best" ending, do the Minutemen questline. You can actually pull off keeping everyone happy except for the Institute, meaning you''ll have access to the radiant quests for every faction except the Institute's after the main questline is done.

You do have to be careful to manage that by the way, you can still go too far within the other faction questlines and piss off the other faction to the point of no return. Go too deep in the Railroad quests and the BoS becomes hostile, the same goes for the other way as well. You can usually access most of the perks the factions offer before you pass the point of no return. For example, you can safely follow the Railroad quests long enough to get to the Ballistics Weave upgrades before things go tits up with the BoS in their questline.

Once you deal with the Institute using the Minutemen resources if everyone is still cool with you you'll be able to do radiant quests from them, the BoS, and the Railroad. It's basically the best possible ending for the game at this point.

The MM are the most balanced morally speaking and get along with basically everyone but the Institute. Everyone else has you being a dick to someone else and screwing people over at some point. They are the closest thing to 'good guys' in the game. Even with the Institute you're expected to minimize casualties by getting as many people out as you can before things go south.

With everyone else, their agenda is paramount to everything else. The Minutemen just want to stabilize the area and make it livable and somewhat civilized so that people can settle down and live in peace.

That might not sound appealing or as much fun as rolling with the other factions, but it is the path to the best ending for the Commonwealth as a whole, and the only way to have access to the most radiant quests once the main quest is over.
